title: Inline
description: Links in running text stay underlined, so color isn't the only cue. muted is for secondary links such as legal text.

title: Standalone
description: A link on its own line drops the underline until hover and takes icons. Arrows mirror in RTL.

title: External
description: external opens a new tab, adds the external-link icon and says so to screen readers. Translate externalLabel.
